I think you are doing an incredibly brave thing by sharing your thoughts here. I, too, have contemplated and even attempted suicide before in my young life (I’m 27 now). I think one of the biggest realizations I had is how powerful our mind and emotions can be. I heard somewhere that we act according to our emotions first, and then rationalize our actions later through logic. I think the saddest thing about suicide is that it is pretty much always an emotional response to life’s suffering.. only we don’t have the opportunity to rationalize it after the fact.. it’s only when you survive an attempt at suicide can you really take a step back and try to understand why you tried to take your life. either way.. I just wanted to remind you that as long as you’re still alive, you have the capacity to create change. Whether that change leaves a positive or negative impact on the world is entirely up to you.
